scheme_name: Scheme of Pension for Eminent Sports Persons
other_conditions: Must have represented India in at least one of the following international competitions: Olympic Games, Official World Cup, Commonwealth Games, Asian Games, Davis Cup (tennis), or Test/One‑Day International matches (cricket).
Must be a veteran sportsperson (men or women) who has brought laurels to the nation or the state.
Must be a Punjab domicile (belonging to Punjab).
Candidates receiving any sports pension from the Government of India are also eligible.
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 for Olympic Games, Official World Cup, Davis Cup and Test/ODI cricket, and ₹600 for Commonwealth and Asian Games.
